_note: SANITIZED sample of GET /devices?views=FULL; key set verified against 1,364 live rows on ExtremeCloud IQ API 25.11.1-3 (2026-07-28). RFC 5737 IPs, fake MACs/serials, invented hostnames. There is deliberately NO 'radios' key: XiqDevice has no such property in the published schema and 0 of 1,364 live rows carried one — radios come from GET /devices/radio-information (see xiq_radio_information.json). An earlier version of this fixture invented a radios[] array ('5G', 'channel', '80MHz', 'clients: 5'), so the radio tests passed against a shape XIQ never sends while ap_radios sat at 0 rows in production. active_clients is present on only ~1/3 of live rows (432 of 1,364), so ap_details.clients_total is legitimately NULL for many APs — the CHS AP below omits it on purpose.
